summary: HPS Corporate Lending Fund filed an 8-K to disclose June 2026 distributions (regular and variable supplemental) and provide an update on its continuous public share offering. The filing reports NAV per share of $24.53 for all classes as of May 31, 2026, aggregate NAV of $12.6 billion, and total consideration of $14.0 billion raised to date under a $15.0 billion offering. This is a routine periodic disclosure of distributions and offering status, not a special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor are mentioned. The filing is solely informational under Items 7.01 and 8.01.
